WITH order_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) as avg_remain
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as overall_avg
  FROM order_avgs
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT 
    oa.ordersmark,
    oa.avg_remain,
    os.overall_avg
  FROM order_avgs oa
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE oa.avg_remain > os.overall_avg
),
filtered_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remain) as filtered_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    ao.ordersmark,
    ao.avg_remain,
    ao.overall_avg,
    fs.filtered_avg
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN filtered_stats fs
  WHERE ao.avg_remain > fs.filtered_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(ff.avg_remain) as avg_of_filtered_avgs,
  AVG(ff.avg_remain - ff.overall_avg) as avg_excess_over_overall,
  AVG(ff.avg_remain - ff.filtered_avg) as avg_excess_over_filtered
FROM final_filtered ff;
